En BICE VIDA somos líderes en el rubro de las aseguradoras en Chile y trabajamos para satisfacer las necesidades de seguridad, prosperidad y protección de nuestros clientes. Estamos viviendo un proceso profundo de transformación digital, explorando nuevas formas de hacer negocio, diseñar experiencias de alto impacto y responder a un entorno cada vez más exigente y cambiante.

Esta oferta se enmarca en la Ley 21.015, que incentiva la inclusión laboral de personas en situación de discapacidad. Las personas interesadas contarán con el apoyo de la Compañía para realizar un proceso inclusivo y en igualdad de condiciones. BICE Vida se compromete a resguardar la información proporcionada de manera voluntaria.

 ¿Qué buscamos? 🔍

En BICE Vida buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Ingeniero/a en Inteligencia Artificial para unirse a la Gerencia de Finanzas y Operaciones.

Tu principal desafío será diseñar, desarrollar, implementar y mantener productos tecnológicos basados en Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning. En este rol, serás un motor clave para impulsar el levantamiento y uso permanente de nuevas tecnologías, promoviendo una cultura Data Driven y fortaleciendo la innovación continua dentro de la compañía.

 ¿Qué harás en este rol? 😎


Levantar, analizar y priorizar necesidades del negocio para construir una cartera de casos de uso de IA con viabilidad, riesgos y valor claramente definidos.
Diseñar, desarrollar, implementar y mantener soluciones de IA de punta a punta (modelos, agentes, APIs y servicios cloud) escalables, seguras y alineadas a la arquitectura.
Definir y monitorear métricas de adopción, eficiencia, costos e impacto para respaldar decisiones de inversión, continuidad y escalamiento de los proyectos.
Incorporar criterios de seguridad, privacidad, ética, trazabilidad y gobierno durante todo el ciclo de vida de las soluciones, reduciendo riesgos asociados al uso de datos y modelos.
Evaluar plataformas, modelos y proveedores mediante pruebas de concepto para recomendar alternativas según su costo, seguridad, integración y escalabilidad.
Capacitar a los equipos en la adopción responsable de las herramientas de IA, documentando los desarrollos e investigando nuevas tendencias para potenciar las capacidades internas.

Titulado/a de Ingeniería Civil, con especialización en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Software o perfiles afines
Nivel avanzado en Python y sus librerías especializadas en Inteligencia Artificial.
Experiencia en el procesamiento y manejo de datos estructurados y no estructurados.
Experiencia práctica en el uso de APIs de Inteligencia Artificial (como Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) y en la creación de APIs para el delivery de modelos.
Conocimiento sobre seguridad, privacidad de datos, ética en IA y optimización de costos.

Desde la Gerencia Corporativa de Tecnología e Innovación buscamos a una persona que disfrute estar entre el negocio y la tecnología, capaz de detectar oportunidades, transformar problemas en soluciones y construir herramientas que realmente sean utilizadas por las personas.

Diseñar y construir automatizaciones que conecten los sistemas del grupo mediante APIs y webhooks.
Desarrollar herramientas internas, agentes y asistentes con Inteligencia Artificial.
Levantar procesos junto a las áreas de negocio, identificar oportunidades y priorizar soluciones de alto impacto.
Trabajar directamente con usuarios, lanzar versiones rápidas, recibir feedback e iterar.
Monitorear, mantener y mejorar las soluciones implementadas en producción.
Analizar datos para comprender problemas y medir el impacto de las soluciones desarrolladas.

Recién egresado/a de Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería Civil en Computación, Ingeniería Informática o carrera afín.

Seguro complementario de salud.

Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.

We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions


Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

What We’re Looking For

PLEASE SUBMIT RESUME IN ENGLISH

Bi- Lingual English/Spanish - Written And Verbal Preferred

We are seeking a highly collaborative, forward-thinking Software Engineer to join the Engineering team & develop delightful new features and experiences for both our external users (customers) and internal users (employees). In addition to possessing extensive knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, Data Structures, CSS, and React, the right candidate is a low-ego team player who approaches engineering problems & potential solutions with a unique, holistic, and long-term perspective, and is genuinely excited to build the software expanding renewable energy access to millions of households across the country.

This role is based out of Santiago, Chile with a hybrid remote first approach and is an exceptional opportunity for someone who relishes the chance to engage with cutting-edge technology, influence how our team builds and stays relevant, and work in a fast-paced environment with engineers on a high-morale, tightly knit team. Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture-- you can read more about them here.

Build reliable, event-driven integrations using messaging (Service Bus/Event Grid) and idempotent processing, so a bill is never lost, duplicated, or paid twice.

Own features end to end, from refinement and design through release and production support, within a regular release cadence.

Write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and maintain CI/CD pipelines so changes ship safely.

Contribute to the migration of legacy components onto our consolidated platform, keeping customer-facing behavior stable.

Run code reviews, share design feedback, and mentor more junior engineers to raise the team’s quality bar.

Work daily with product, QA, and US-based engineers across time zones, communicating clearly in English (written and spoken) and flagging risks early.

6+ years of prior experience in a software engineering role

→ Escribir tests rigurosos (unitarios, integración, evals) y participar activamente en code review

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?


Desarrollar features y resolver bugs que sean asignados por el Engineering Manager, cumpliendo siempre con los estándares de calidad y los patrones de IA definidos por el squad.
Trabajar en par con un Product Engineer en la misión asignada para recibir contexto de negocio, traducirlo en implementación técnica y entregar incrementos funcionales.

Integrar nuevas features sobre los pipelines de IA existentes del squad (como RAG, prompt chains y servicios de modelo), siguiendo siempre los contratos y patrones ya definidos.
Revisar y validar el output generado por agentes de IA antes de integrarlo, asegurando que el código de un agente no se fusione (merge) sin revisión humana.
Escribir tests unitarios y de integración para los desarrollos, incluyendo cobertura específica para el código que haya sido generado por IA.
Participar de manera activa en code reviews, aprendiendo de las revisiones realizadas por el Engineering Manager y los AI Engineers Senior.
Documentar las decisiones técnicas y los patrones de implementación directamente en la base de conocimiento del equipo.
Participar en la demostración (demo) semanal para mostrar un progreso tangible de los desarrollos.


IA (Responsabilidades gestionadas con Inteligencia Artificial)


Construcción de features con agentes: Deberás usar agentes de IA para construir features de ciclo completo, abarcando la implementación funcional end-to-end y no solo para scaffolding, boilerplate, tests o refactoring. Es obligatorio revisar, entender y validar todo el output antes de commitearlo.
Debugging asistido: Tendrás que usar agentes para analizar logs, stack traces y proponer fixes, validando siempre la solución antes de aplicarla.
Documentación asistida: Deberás usar agentes para generar la documentación técnica de las features implementadas, siendo responsable de revisar su precisión y completitud.
Responsabilidad sobre el código: Responderás por el output del agente como si fuera propio; no existe la excusa de "lo generó la IA", por lo que si se mergea con tu nombre, es tuyo.


KPIs (Métricas que impactarás)


Core Web Vitals: Tu trabajo no debe degradar las métricas LCP, INP ni CLS en las vistas desarrolladas.
DORA: Se evaluará el Lead Time for Changes (tiempo desde el primer commit hasta producción), el Change Failure Rate (proporción de despliegues que requieren remediación) y tu contribución directa a la Deployment Frequency del equipo.
System Health: Se espera que el Error rate y la latencia de los servicios que toques no se degraden tras implementar tus cambios.
Proceso agéntico del AI PDLC: Se medirá el porcentaje del output de agentes revisado antes de hacer un merge, el Leverage de IA (el output entregado con asistencia de agentes vs. sin ella) y la adopción de los workflows del AI PDLC que han sido definidos por el squad.

Contar con más de 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software profesional.
Poseer dominio de al menos un lenguaje backend (Python, Java, C# o Node.js) y de un framework frontend (React, Next.js, Vue o Angular) utilizando Programación Orientada a Objetos (POO).
Tener experiencia utilizando herramientas de AI-assisted coding (como Claude Code, Copilot o Cursor) aplicadas en un flujo de trabajo real.
Poseer nociones prácticas en prompt engineering y en el consumo de APIs de LLMs.
Mostrar familiaridad con bases de datos relacionales y el consumo/creación de APIs REST.
Tener experiencia demostrable en la creación y ejecución de tests unitarios y de integración.
Contar con experiencia utilizando Git, herramientas de CI/CD básico y metodologías de flujos de trabajo en equipo.


Nice to Have (Deseable):


Contar con experiencia en empresas SaaS B2B o en productos de ventas Self Service, así como en sistemas de autenticación/autorización y en la integración con pasarelas de pago y sistemas de facturación.
Haber trabajado a nivel de uso real con sistemas RAG, embeddings o vector stores.
Tener familiaridad con entornos de arquitectura de microservicios.
Poseer conocimientos básicos sobre Docker y Kubernetes.
Contar con experiencia en herramientas de observabilidad de aplicaciones, tales como New Relic o tecnologías equivalentes.

descripcion_completa:
Responsabilidades

Ser dueño/a de la arquitectura backend: definir hacia dónde evoluciona, documentar decisiones (ADRs) y defenderlas con datos ante stakeholders técnicos y de producto.
Diseñar y liderar iniciativas técnicas de largo plazo: modernizar el stack, separar responsabilidades del monolito, reducir deuda técnica crítica, sin detener la entrega de producto.
Anticipar problemas de escala antes de que lleguen a producción y definir cómo se mide rendimiento, disponibilidad y costo.
Definir estándares del equipo: diseño de código, testing, seguridad, code review y uso de IA en el desarrollo.
Liderar la respuesta a incidentes complejos y convertir cada uno en mejoras permanentes del sistema, no solo en soluciones temporales.
Ser mentor/a de ingenieros/as menos senior: revisar diseños, entregar feedback técnico y ayudarlos a crecer profesionalmente.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en propuestas técnicas con alcance, riesgos y costos claros, y desafiar decisiones cuando no aporten valor.




Requisitos

5 o más años construyendo soluciones backend en producción, con al menos 2 años tomando decisiones de arquitectura en sistemas con usuarios reales. Experiencia sólida en uno o más lenguajes y frameworks de desarrollo backend (Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, Go, Ruby u otros), con capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a nuevas tecnologías.
Haber diseñado o rediseñado sistemas que crecieron en volumen de datos, cantidad de usuarios o integraciones, y poder explicar las decisiones tomadas, las alternativas descartadas y los aprendizajes obtenidos.
Pensar la escalabilidad a nivel de sistema: anticipar qué puede fallar cuando la carga crece 10x, identificar cuellos de botella (bases de datos, colas, integraciones externas) y comprender cómo se comporta el sistema frente a fallos. “You shared their post. Don’t you also partner with their competitor?”
I do. And I’ll probably share theirs tomorrow.

Occasionally, a partner or buyer asks how I can support multiple providers in the same market. If I believe in one, how can I believe in another?
Because “best” needs a follow-up question:

Best for whom?
Asking for the best technology provider is a little like asking for the best restaurant. Are we planning an anniversary dinner, feeding a family, or grabbing lunch between meetings? A great recommendation starts with understanding what someone needs.

The same applies to the companies we serve.
Some prioritize exceptional customer support. Some want the newest technology. Others need a proven solution with years of reliability behind it.Industry, company size, budget, existing systems, and appetite for change all shape the answer.

My job is to understand those differences well enough to make a useful recommendation—and be honest about where each solution fits and where it doesn’t.

That’s what makes supporting multiple partners valuable. It takes curiosity, judgment, and the willingness to look beyond your own favorites.

And while we compete for business, there’s plenty of work left to do. Across this market, people are building products that help companies operate better and improve work for employees. We can respect that effort while still competing hard.

Sharing a partner’s work isn’t a claim that they’re the right answer for every buyer. It’s recognition that they bring something valuable to the market.

So yes, I amplify a wide range of partners. And yes, I believe in best-in-class solutions.
The class—and the customer—matter.

There’s room for all of us. The responsibility is knowing where we can each make the biggest difference.

¡En Proyectum queremos que seas nuestro próximo Líder Técnico Backend – Semi Senior!




Proyectum Chile brinda como propósito promover la aplicación de prácticas profesionales de Dirección de Proyectos, ofreciendo servicios de capacitación y consultoría.




Junto a 12 países latinoamericanos compartimos marca, imagen corporativa y una serie de activos de información (Cursos, productos de consultoría y otros), nos presentamos como una organización internacional.




Somos el principal ATP (Authorized Training Partner) del PMI en Latinoamérica, liderando la Dirección Exitosa de Proyectos y en la Agilidad.




Buscamos un Líder Técnico con experiencia en desarrollo backend, arquitectura de APIs y liderazgo de equipos tecnológicos, capaz de impulsar soluciones robustas, escalables y mantenibles, integrando criterios técnicos con una visión centrada en la experiencia de usuario (UX).




El desafío será asegurar la calidad técnica de las soluciones, orientar al equipo de desarrollo y promover buenas prácticas, manteniendo una colaboración efectiva entre tecnología, UX y negocio.




El cargo se desempeñará en Santiago de Chile, bajo una modalidad híbrida y jornada laboral completa.




Funciones principales

Liderar técnicamente al equipo de desarrollo, estableciendo estándares, buenas prácticas y criterios de calidad del código.
Diseñar y supervisar soluciones backend, APIs REST y microservicios utilizando Golang (Gin) y Node.js, incluyendo Workers en Go sobre AKS.
Alinear los requerimientos funcionales y criterios UX con las decisiones de arquitectura y desarrollo.
Implementar buenas prácticas avanzadas de Go, incluyendo concurrencia, manejo de contextos e integración con MongoDB y SQL Server.
Definir y documentar contratos de APIs mediante Swagger/OpenAPI, gestionando su publicación y control de acceso con Azure API Management.
Diseñar integraciones asíncronas y soluciones orientadas a eventos mediante Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs y Azure Functions.
Supervisar repositorios, ramas, pull requests y pipelines CI/CD mediante Azure DevOps y Git/Gitflow.
Monitorear rendimiento, trazabilidad y errores mediante Azure Application Insights, acompañando despliegues en AKS/Kubernetes.
Realizar revisiones de código, orientar técnicamente al equipo y resolver impedimentos.
Participar en ceremonias ágiles, incluyendo dailies y planning.




Educación

Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Informática, Ingeniería en Computación, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ingeniería de Software o carreras afines.




Requisitos excluyentes

Experiencia comprobable de al menos 3 años en las siguientes tecnologías, herramientas y conocimientos técnicos:




Experiencia liderando técnicamente equipos de desarrollo, realizando revisiones de código y aplicando criterios UX.
Experiencia en desarrollo backend con Golang (Go), Node.js, APIs REST, microservicios, framework Gin y Workers sobre AKS.
Conocimiento avanzado de Go: structs, interfaces, composición, métodos, punteros, slices, maps y generics.
Experiencia en concurrencia con goroutines, channels, worker pools y manejo de context.Context, incluyendo propagación y cancelación coordinada.
Experiencia con bases de datos MongoDB y SQL Server, incluyendo integración desde aplicaciones Go.
Manejo de Azure DevOps, Git/Gitflow y pipelines CI/CD.
Experiencia con Azure API Management y Swagger/OpenAPI para administración, documentación y control de acceso a APIs.
Conocimientos de Azure Application Insights para monitoreo, trazabilidad y diagnóstico.
Experiencia con Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus y Azure Event Hubs.
Conocimientos básicos de AKS/Kubernetes en Microsoft Azure.
Experiencia trabajando con metodologías ágiles, orientación técnica a desarrolladores y resolución autónoma de problemas.




Requisitos deseables

Experiencia en arquitecturas de microservicios, soluciones orientadas a eventos y enfoques serverless.
Experiencia coordinando equipos de desarrollo, arquitectura, UX y negocio en entornos de alta criticidad.
Experiencia realizando mentoring técnico a equipos de desarrollo.




Aptitudes personales

Liderazgo técnico y capacidad para movilizar equipos.
Comunicación clara y efectiva de decisiones técnicas.
Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas complejos.
Autonomía, criterio técnico y capacidad de priorización.
Orientación a la calidad, mantenibilidad y buenas prácticas.
Colaboración con equipos multidisciplinarios.
Proactividad y anticipación de riesgos técnicos.
Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión.
Orientación al usuario y sensibilidad por la experiencia UX.

Some days, work takes you out of the office and meeting rooms, and into places that remind you why the work matters. 

A recent visit to TATA Power at Walvan Dam, Lonavala was one such day. Instead of conversations around a conference table, we had our discussions in the open air, surrounded by the greenery of the Western Ghats. We also spent time learning about their remarkable Mahseer conservation programme, its afforestation efforts across the catchment areas, and its work to document and protect the biodiversity of this ecologically rich region. It was fascinating to learn about a conservation journey spanning decades, and how these sustained efforts have contributed to the Blue-finned Mahseer moving to the “Least Concern” category on the IUCN Red List. 

The visit also took us to a local school supported by TATA Power, where we had the opportunity to meet children from tribal communities and see how access to education is opening up possibilities for their future. 

What stayed with me from the day was how conservation, communities and opportunity are so deeply connected. There is tremendous potential when organisations bring together their strengths and a shared commitment to social impact. Looking forward to exploring how we at Tata Consultancy Services can collaborate with TATA Power to create meaningful and lasting impact for communities together. And yes, I would happily trade a few more conference-room meetings for conversations surrounded by the hills and greenery of Lonavala! 😊

Who We Are

We're a small team that believes providing access to better financial insights and tools improves people’s lives, so we’re taking money matters into our own hands.

Our product is a personal finance management app for iOS and Mac that people actually love using. Copilot takes advantage of machine learning to deliver powerful, hyper-personalized finance data insights to help users effortlessly understand and manage their spending, budgeting, and investing. We also use crowdsourced feedback to continuously improve the experience.

The Role

We’ve built a best-in-class app for iOS and Mac, and now we’ve expanded to Web and Android with the same high-quality user experience. To support this, we need robust backend APIs and infrastructure that can scale efficiently across platforms.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to play a key role in designing and developing these backend systems. You’ll collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to scope, build, and optimize APIs and services that power Copilot across all platforms.

This is a hybrid position based in Santiago, Chile, you’ll be required to come into our office at least 2 times a week along with the rest of the team. We work from home the rest of the week, but the office is always available in case you want to make use of it more often.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs that support iOS, macOS, Android, and Web applications.
Contribute to architecture and infrastructure discussions, recommending improvements to ensure scalability, security, and performance.
Collaborate with Product and Client teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Participate in code reviews, ensuring best practices and high-quality standards.
Contribute to ongoing improvements in developer experience and system reliability.
Support the team in technical decision-making and mentor junior engineers as needed.


Required Qualifications


5+ years of experience working on backend services.
Strong proficiency in Node.js / JavaScript (TypeScript a plus)
Experience with Google Cloud Platform
Hands-on experience with API design and architecture for mobile and web applications.
English proficiency — all meetings and internal communications are conducted in English.
Team player who can manage time independently.
Based in Santiago, Chile 


Desired Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
Experience with Firebase / Firestore, CI/CD systems, and monitoring tools.
Familiarity with performance optimization, scalability, and alerting infrastructure.
Prior exposure to mentoring or supporting peers in a collaborative engineering environment.


Compensation And Benefits


Monthly salary of CLP $3.300.000 - $3.800.000 (líquido).
Equity in the company (Stock options).
Home Office Setup.
Complementary health insurance.
Remote work allowance (CLP $50.000/month).
Wellness allowance (CLP $85.000/month).
We cover sick days that your health insurance doesn’t pay (usually the first 3 days of a medical leave).
After 2 years in the company you get 5 extra vacation days, and 5 more after 4 years.
Extra free day for your birthday 🥳 (you can take it any day of the month).
4 administrative days per year (non-accumulable).
Annual company retreats.


Why should you work with us?

A product people love: Copilot users are extremely engaged with the app and are sharing it with their friends and family.

A team that cares: We’re a bunch of geeks who care about data quality and good coffee. We go the extra mile when it comes to making our users happy (and making an excellent pour-over).

Significant impact: We are currently a small, twenty-five-person team with big ambitions. Our team has previous experience at companies like Google and Apple.

Multicultural team: We’re based in NYC 🇺🇸 and in Santiago, Chile 🇨🇱.

Great company culture: You’ll work with a highly collaborative team that’s always learning and ready to help each other out.

At Copilot Money, we believe that diverse teams build better products. We strongly encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

The Opportunity 

EY is a professional services firm with one of our business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace.

At FSO Technology we deliver project-based work and managed services to our clients. Here, you’ll work as part of a project team and will be responsible for the design, build/configuration, testing, analysis, delivery and support of technology solutions. This position is fast-paced and ever-changing, which means you’ll need to be a flexible self-starter and be able to manage changing priorities and learn new and rapidly changing technology solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be

The goal is to support our clients to transform their business problems through engineering solutions. You will assist engagement teams through the analysis of specific business requirements, design, develop, integrate, test and deploy distributed software applications. You will deliver high quality systems with focus on reliability and excellent customer experience. You will demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.

Skills And Attributes For Success


Delivering engineering solutions through all phases of the project lifecycle, including requirements definition, engineering design, development, integration, and testing; based on a proven agile methodology.
Demonstrate hands-on technical capabilities in multiple programming languages.
Effectively work with client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds, fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment. 
Demonstrate understanding of current technology environment and industry trends and provide recommendations for engagement and client service issues. 


Skills And Requirements We Are Looking For

To qualify for the role, you must have


Bachelor’s degree in computer science or another related field.
Reside in Chile.
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in technology software development.
Leveraging languages, libraries and frameworks that support large, complex web applications which must include the following Html5, css3, sass (ooCSS, BEM), bootstrap 3, Material Design for Angular JS (ES5, ES2015, ES7), Angular 12+, Redux (NgRx), Patron “Containers & Components”, Singleton Services, Factory, (RxJS), Node 8 o superior, express 4. local storage.
Consuming RESTful APIs and JSON data in web applications and with REST API tools such as Postman or similar.
Web security and working with OWASP security considerations and techniques.
Experience with one or any combination of the following modern front-end technologies: React, NextJS, Angular 12 +, Node.js, Electron, React Native or Vue.js
Experience with one or a combination of the modern collaborative development and code management tools including: Git (BitBucket, GitHub or similar) as well as CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Sonar, Mock, Test Case, TeamCity or similar).
Developing, packaging, testing, debugging and deploying responsive web applications.
Experience working with testing frameworks and tools for unit and integration testing and knowledge of Test Driven Development or Behavior Driven Development software development techniques (Selenium, Cucumber, JMeter y Angular CLI, Jest).
Comfortable working in an Agile and TDD environment.
Fluent English

 Funciones del cargo

Responsabilidades Clave


Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Frontend: diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones frontend utilizando React y TypeScript, asegurando soluciones funcionales, eficientes y alineadas a los requerimientos del negocio.

Integración y Despliegue Continuo: colaborar en procesos de integración continua y despliegue continuo (CI/CD).
Actualización Tecnológica Continua: mantenerse actualizado respecto a nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y mejores prácticas del ecosistema frontend.

 Experiencia y Formación

Profesional titulado en Ingeniería Informática, Software, Computación o carreras afines, con más de 3 años de experiencia como Frontend Developer o Software Engineer.

Experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles con React Native, TypeScript y Expo, integración de APIs REST, manejo de estado (Redux, Zustand o Context API) y trabajo en entornos ágiles (Scrum/Kanban).

Conocimientos en integración de módulos nativos (Kotlin y/o Swift), publicación de aplicaciones en App Store y Google Play, testing (Jest, Testing Library, Detox), control de versiones con Git y buenas prácticas de desarrollo (Clean Code, arquitectura basada en componentes, seguridad y resiliencia).

Se valorará experiencia en GraphQL, CI/CD móvil (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, EAS Build), Storybook, Next.js, React Web y entornos fintech, banca o pagos, así como el uso de herramientas de IA generativa aplicadas al desarrollo de software.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Mobile Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Software Engineer focused on our mobile app, you will be responsible for solving challenges in our highest-traffic applications, with your work having a direct impact on our customers and product. Day-to-day, you’ll partner with your team to build out features and products in our React Native-based mobile app. In this role, you’ll also provide support for our mobile app as a platform, working closely with engineers from multiple teams to support larger product releases. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

Compensation:

Sezzle is a U.S. based company listed on NASDAQ. Salary ranges are:


Mid: $3,000 - $4,500 USD per month


Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.


Application submitted (you are here)
Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)
Interview with recruiters (30 min)
Interview with engineers (1 hour)
Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
Offer!


What You'll Do:


Work within our cross-platform TypeScript React Native app to build and maintain new innovative product features.
Actively learn new areas of the product, and collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
Work with the team to continuously build clean, scalable, robust, and testable code
Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders


What We Look For:


Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
Bachelor's in computer science (preferred) or equivalent related experience
Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, Javascript or Typescript, with React Native or React (web) experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


Preferred Knowledge and Skills:


Experience developing and delivering a mobile application to a mobile app store (App Store or Google Play Store)
Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
Familiar with the basic principles and design of React Native Apps, and RESTful APIs
Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


Sezzle’s Technology Stack:


Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. What makes a company stop being just the place where you work and become a place where you grow as a person? 💜

I’ve been trying to write this for days, and I keep coming back to the same word. Gratitude.
Something changes when you finally sit across from someone with no agenda in between. You stop seeing the coworker who fixes a problem or replies to a message, and you start seeing the person. You hear where they come from, what drives them and everything they had to overcome to get where they are. And you realize how little you knew, and how much you were missing.

But what stayed with me most happened in the small moments. In a conversation that ran longer than planned, in a story someone shared with an open heart and in people from other teams who taught me so much just by being who they are.

I came home with more questions than answers, and I think that’s a good thing. It made me reflect on what kind of teammate I want to be, how well I really listen and how often I form an idea of someone based on the little I get to see.

Proverbs 27:17 says “As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.” I always read it as learning from others. This week I understood it’s also about opening your heart. Letting someone challenge you, shape you and make you better. And that only happens when you get close.

Thank you also for every thoughtful gesture and gift. They made me happy in a way I didn’t expect, because behind each one was someone who thought of me.

I thank God, because none of this is a coincidence. And thank you, Sezzle, for investing in what no dashboard can measure, people. To everyone who organized every detail and to each person who was part of this week, thank you. I’m leaving with so much more than I came with. 🙏

4 o más años de experiencia. 
Familiaridad con bases de datos relacionales como PostgreSQL.

Description

About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a mid-level full-stack engineer who likes owning real problems end-to-end, from API design and frontend experience through to backend services, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, build and modernize the platform across the stack, and ship customer-facing features as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small engineering team with direct access to product, design, and compliance, own services in production, make design decisions within your domain, and partner with architects and team leads on bigger design decisions.

What You'll Do


Build and ship features across the stack that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
Ship customer-facing features that customers use every day, from the interface through to the services behind them.
Own your services in production, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
Partner with product, design, and compliance from problem framing through launch.
Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across prototyping, refactoring, testing, and documentation.
Help modernize the platform by taking parts from legacy services into the modern stack, alongside architects and team leads in your domain.


What We're Looking For

Must-have


3 to 6 years building production web applications, end-to-end.
Strong frontend proficiency with Vue.js, React, or equivalent.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
Solid SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests as part of how you ship.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience on AWS, including hands-on deployment and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
Solid CS fundamentals and pragmatic system design.
Strong communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design.


Nice-to-have


Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Service-oriented or microservices architecture experience.
CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices.
Frontend fundamentals: responsive design, accessibility, web performance, and internationalization.
Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

Birthday day off

Remittance service with no commission for immediate family
Annual salary reviews

 Automation

Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and upgrades
Build reusable automation components to improve scalability and consistency
Reduce manual operations through process automation and scripting

Provisioning
Configuration
Upgrades & patching
Decommissioning

Monitoring
Logging
Alerting
Ensure end-to-end observability of platforms and pipelines
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on incidents
Contribute to improving system reliability, SLAs, and operational KPIs

Data provisioning
Data masking for non-prod environments
Data sampling and reduction
Support database operations:
Migration
Sanitization
Reconciliation
Ensure compliance with security and data governance requirements
 Incident & Support Management

Ensure proper documentation and knowledge sharing
 Collaboration & Delivery Enablement

Development teams (integration into CI/CD pipelines)
QA teams (test automation and environment consistency)
Product teams (release readiness and constraints)
Client teams (technical coordination and delivery)
Contribute to smooth delivery across project lifecycle
 Continuous Improvement & Best Practices
Promote DevOps principles:
Automation-first
Continuous integration & delivery
Shift-left testing
Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements
Contribute to:
Internal tooling
Documentation
Standardization efforts

 Descripción del trabajo

“You shared their post. Don’t you also partner with their competitor?”
I do. And I’ll probably share theirs tomorrow.

Occasionally, a partner or buyer asks how I can support multiple providers in the same market. If I believe in one, how can I believe in another?
Because “best” needs a follow-up question:

Best for whom?
Asking for the best technology provider is a little like asking for the best restaurant. Are we planning an anniversary dinner, feeding a family, or grabbing lunch between meetings? A great recommendation starts with understanding what someone needs.

The same applies to the companies we serve.
Some prioritize exceptional customer support. Some want the newest technology. Others need a proven solution with years of reliability behind it.Industry, company size, budget, existing systems, and appetite for change all shape the answer.

My job is to understand those differences well enough to make a useful recommendation—and be honest about where each solution fits and where it doesn’t.

That’s what makes supporting multiple partners valuable. It takes curiosity, judgment, and the willingness to look beyond your own favorites.

And while we compete for business, there’s plenty of work left to do. Across this market, people are building products that help companies operate better and improve work for employees. We can respect that effort while still competing hard.

Sharing a partner’s work isn’t a claim that they’re the right answer for every buyer. It’s recognition that they bring something valuable to the market.

So yes, I amplify a wide range of partners. And yes, I believe in best-in-class solutions.
The class—and the customer—matter.

There’s room for all of us. The responsibility is knowing where we can each make the biggest difference.

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of


Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.


The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as an Agentic GCP DevOps Engineer.


You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.


What We're Looking For


5+ years of professional Software Engineering / DevOps experience.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows and agentic AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) integrated into daily development routines.
Advanced English is required.
Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
Production experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically managing services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, and GKE.
Proven track record of designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications in production environments.
Hands-on Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) experience using Terraform or Deployment Manager to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.
Production experience with containerization and orchestration, including Docker and Kubernetes (GKE).
Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability solutions using tools such as Google Cloud Observability (Stackdriver), Prometheus, or Grafana.
Demonstrated experience optimizing GCP infrastructure for scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
Forensic attention to detail.
A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.


Work Authorization Requirements


Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.


What We Offer


Competitive pay in your local currency.
100% remote work.
The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
English Classes.
Ample opportunity for career advancement.
Continuing education opportunities.
Depending on your location other benefits may apply.

Job Description: Ingeniero/a DevOps Cloud – GCP / AWS

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a DevOps con experiencia práctica en ambientes Cloud, automatización, infraestructura como código y operación de Kubernetes. La persona deberá contar con capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, resolver incidentes y acompañar técnicamente a equipos de desarrollo.

El foco principal del cargo estará en Google Cloud Platform (GCP), complementado con conocimientos y experiencia en AWS, apoyando la evolución, automatización y operación confiable de la plataforma digital.

Objetivo del cargo

Profesional especializado en prácticas DevOps y plataformas Cloud, responsable de diseñar, implementar y mantener procesos de automatización, despliegue, infraestructura y operación, asegurando estabilidad, escalabilidad, observabilidad y seguridad en los ambientes tecnológicos.

Principales responsabilidades

Diseñar, implementar y mantener pipelines de CI/CD.

Trabajar con GitHub Actions y/o Harness CI/CD.

Gestionar infraestructura como código mediante Terraform / OpenTofu.

Administrar infraestructura Cloud sobre GCP y AWS.

Operar clústeres Kubernetes, incluyendo despliegues, configuraciones, escalabilidad y actualizaciones.

Trabajar con Helm y manifests para la gestión de despliegues.

Implementar y mantener soluciones de observabilidad, incluyendo métricas, dashboards, alertas, logs y trazas.

Apoyar técnicamente a equipos de desarrollo en integraciones, configuraciones y resolución de incidentes.

Analizar y resolver incidentes asociados a infraestructura, despliegues y componentes Cloud.

Identificar riesgos, vulnerabilidades y brechas técnicas en infraestructura Cloud y procesos de despliegue.

Proponer y documentar acciones de mitigación y mejoras técnicas.

Contribuir a la automatización y estandarización de procesos DevOps.

Promover buenas prácticas de seguridad, disponibilidad y confiabilidad de la plataforma.

GCP – principal

Cloud Security y gestión de vulnerabilidades.

Gestión y resolución de incidentes.

descripcion_completa:
En BC Tecnología somos una consultora de TI que diseña y entrega soluciones a través de equipos ágiles, con foco en el cliente. Participamos en proyectos y servicios de soporte y administración IT para industrias como servicios financieros, seguros, retail y gobierno. En este rol nos integraremos a nuestro equipo de TI para fortalecer la operación y evolución de plataformas Cloud en Microsoft Azure, trabajando en la administración de infraestructura y en la habilitación de automatización y seguridad. Buscamos impulsar entregas confiables, monitoreo eficiente y control de costos (FinOps) para que los equipos de proyecto cuenten con una base Cloud robusta y escalable.

 Principales responsabilidades

En BC Tecnología buscamos un/a Ingeniero de Infraestructura Cloud Azure para integrarse a nuestro equipo de TI y contribuir al ciclo operativo y de evolución de nuestra plataforma Cloud.


Administrar y operar la infraestructura en Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS).
Gestionar requerimientos, incidentes y cambios sobre la plataforma, asegurando continuidad operacional.
Implementar automatización mediante Terraform, Bicep o ARM, promoviendo despliegues consistentes y reproducibles.
Monitorear rendimiento, disponibilidad y costos de la infraestructura con prácticas de FinOps.
Fortalecer la seguridad de la plataforma usando Microsoft Entra ID, IAM y buenas prácticas de seguridad.
Apoyar técnicamente a los equipos de proyecto en soluciones Cloud, aportando criterios de diseño, operación y confiabilidad.


El objetivo es que la plataforma Azure sea estable, segura, controlada en costos y preparada para escalar, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y mejora continua.

 Requisitos

Para este rol buscamos a una persona con formación técnica y experiencia inicial/temprana demostrable en administración de Microsoft Azure.


Formación: Ingeniería en Informática, Computación o carrera afín.
Experiencia: al menos 1 año administrando plataformas Microsoft Azure.
Conocimientos: Azure, Terraform, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Azure Monitor y prácticas de CI/CD.
Deseable: familiaridad con FinOps e ITIL, y/o contar con certificación Azure AZ-104.

¿Hay un proceso en tu empresa que todos saben que no funciona, pero nadie ha logrado arreglar?

Es la conversación que más tenemos en TIPartner. A veces es un equipo que pasa días en tareas manuales. Otras, un proceso crítico que vive en una hoja de cálculo o depende de una sola persona. La información del cliente repartida en varios sistemas. Una normativa con el plazo encima. Un cambio de sistema que da miedo. Un proveedor que entregó y nadie sabe si funciona. O, simplemente, más proyectos que personas.

Desde 2009 acompañamos a grandes empresas a resolver exactamente eso, en industrias tan distintas como seguros, previsión, banca, retail, alimentos, salud y el sector público. El problema cambia de nombre, pero se parece más de lo que uno cree. Hemos visto cómo una cuadratura que tomaba toda la mañana pasa a tomar 15 minutos, cómo una tarea que ocupaba a siete personas durante un día completo hoy se hace en menos de media hora, y cómo nueve de cada diez solicitudes de post venta de una aseguradora hoy se resuelven solas.

Nuestra forma de trabajar parte por entender el problema de negocio antes de hablar de tecnología. Nos integramos al equipo del cliente, trabajamos con cercanía y nos hacemos cargo hasta que el problema queda resuelto.

Han confiado en nosotros Sura, AFP Capital, MetLife, Zurich Santander, Vida Cámara, AFP Habitat, Alemana Seguros, BCI Seguros, Colmena, Banco Santander, Itaú, Banco Central, BancoEstado, Scotiabank, Coval, Cencosud, Watts, Teletón y SERNAC, entre otras.

2 días

Unsafe Conditions = Indirect Financial Losses

In one of my previous organizations, I have witnessed the financial losses due to poor working conditions. 

There were various enclosed huge halls in which around 1500 workers used to work. In these halls chemical fumes and heat used to be generated due to a chemical reaction. Workers' profile included, handling 320 times a 3 kg weight by leaning over the chemical channel. Though there were exhaust and cooling systems, but  all were run at half their efficiency to save power and there by expenses. Also there were no nose masks and safety goggles given to them in order to save the expenses.

But the result was horrific. Due to poor ventilation, high temperature, and no PPEs the workmen's eyes used to sore up frequently and excessive sweating used to result in fatigue. Due to which there used to be always an absenteeism of 35%. Even if people were called or personally visited their homes to request to come for the job, these absent workmen used to not show up. The result was high absenteeism resulting in high overtimes, and high employee turnover. Both were hurting financially.

When the analysis was done, it was quite visible that the cost of thousands of overtime was much more than the cost of PPEs and power consumption meant for exhausts and air conditioners.

When workmen were  provided with appropriate PPEs, and ventilation & working temperature were made more comfortable. The result was positive. The overtimes almost decreased by 90% and thus the losses incurred were eliminated. Not only there were financial benefits but also the health of the workmen was not affected badly due to improved working conditions.

Engineering control in the Hierarchy of Controls can be a very effective tool in EHS, to make the workplace safer and eliminate the indirect financial losses occurring due to these unsafe conditions.

Be Safe, Live Safe!

Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.

Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.

Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.

This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.

Job posting end date: 11/15/2026

Introduction

We are looking for a Data Product Engineer to design, build, deploy and operate scalable data products, pipelines and platform capabilities that enable analytics, digital solutions and AI across Metso. You will transform data from multiple enterprise source systems into trusted, reusable and business-ready data assets, contributing throughout the data product lifecycle from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to use modern engineering practices and enterprise data platforms while solving practical business challenges in a global industrial organization.

The position is part of Metso’s Data & Analytics organization and reports to the Director, Data Enablement. The preferred locations for this position are some of Metso’s biggest locations: Espoo, Tampere or Lappeenranta, Finland; Krakow, Poland; Vadodara, India; Vilnius, Lithuania; York, USA; Sorocaba, Brazil; or Santiago, Chile. We are happy to offer flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options.

Team you’ll belong to 

You will join Metso’s data engineering community and work closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, AI teams and Data Enablement professionals. Together, we create reliable and reusable data products that support reporting, advanced analytics, digital products, and AI.

You will collaborate with business stakeholders, application teams, enterprise architecture, platform, integration, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.

What You’ll Do



Design, develop and maintain reusable and scalable data products, data models, and end-to-end pipelines for ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery. 
Contribute to enterprise data platforms and shared services by implementing reusable engineering patterns, frameworks, and automation capabilities. 
Improve scalability, performance, reliability and operational efficiency, and support integration between enterprise systems and analytical platforms. 
Embed data quality, automated testing, validation, monitoring and observability into pipelines and data products. 
Monitor data availability and operational stability, investigate issues, and implement sustainable corrective solutions. 
Apply modern software engineering practices, including source control, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps and DataOps. 
Implement technical governance requirements for metadata, lineage, documentation, access controls, security and compliance. 
Collaborate with architects, analytics and AI teams, business stakeholders and source-system teams throughout solution design and delivery. 



What You’ll Bring



Experience or demonstrated capability in data engineering, data integration, data products, and pipeline development. 
Practical skills in SQL and Python. 
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehousing, or lakehouse architectures. 
Knowledge of data modelling, transformation design, and integration patterns. 
Experience with CI/CD, DevOps or DataOps practices and secure, maintainable software development. 
Understanding of automated testing, data quality, monitoring, observability, metadata and data lineage. 
Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills with an analytical and structured approach. 
Ability to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, communicate clearly and balance technical quality, delivery needs and business value. 
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Palantir or Databricks is considered valuable. You bring a strong engineering discipline, quality and product mindset, and continuous improvement orientation.

descripcion_completa:
Contribuye a transformar nuestro futuro. 




Los metales son esenciales para el mundo en que vivimos, pero históricamente la minería ha enfrentado problemas de con los residuos, la sostenibilidad y la ineficiencia. En MineSense estamos demostrando que puede ser diferente y cambiando esa historia. Nuestras soluciones reducen los residuos y el impacto ambiental de la minería, y al mismo tiempo aumentando las ganancias y la eficiencia. Contamos con los fondos líderes de capital de riesgos y apoyo de programas gubernamentales, y hemos sido reconocidos unan y otra vez por la industria tecnológica y programas de sostenibilidad, MineSense está haciendo lo que muchos creían imposible: reinventar la minería para construir un mejor futuro para todos. 




Buscamos incorporar a un(a) Project Manager - Senior con experiencia a nuestro equipo de Servicios en Terreno en Santiago, Chile. La persona ideal será proactiva, orientada al detalle y motivada por desarrollar soluciones innovadoras.




El propósito principal del cargo es gestionar los proyectos de entrega a clientes de MineSense. La persona liderará los proyectos desde las últimas etapas de la oportunidad comercial, pasando por la entrega, la puesta en marcha y la fase comercial, hasta la renovación, en Sudamérica. Trabajará estrechamente con los equipos multifuncionales de MineSense para asegurar que los compromisos con los clientes sean ejecutables, que los riesgos se gestionen activamente y que el avance sea visible mediante reportes consistentes y una comunicación efectiva con las partes interesadas. También colaborará con los cargos senior de la organización del cliente en faena para asegurar que los sistemas MineSense entreguen el valor esperado, minimizando las interrupciones de las operaciones habituales del sitio. Este cargo requiere experiencia en gestión de proyectos y en la industria minera, específicamente en funciones relacionadas con la entrega de tecnología de hardware y software a clientes.




Funciones del Cargo Gestión de Proyectos




Actúa como principal punto de contacto con los clientes para todos los temas, actualizaciones y solicitudes de cambio, desde la entrega y puesta en marcha hasta la fase comercial y la renovación. 


Asume la responsabilidad integral de liderar, gestionar y coordinar los proyectos para cumplir con las especificaciones del cliente y asegurar su satisfacción. 


Desarrolla y gestiona planes e hitos de proyecto que aseguren la mitigación de riesgos. 


Gestiona los permisos necesarios relacionados con los requisitos del proyecto. 


Impulsa la finalización de tareas por parte de todas las áreas, la resolución de problemas y la implementación de planes de mitigación de riesgos, según sea necesario para alcanzar los objetivos del proyecto. 


Identifica riesgos o restricciones del proyecto, barreras de ejecución e impactos en la programación, y asegura que las áreas responsables de la empresa tomen las acciones correspondientes. 


Evalúa los distintos impactos organizacionales tanto para el cliente como para MineSense al considerar soluciones a los problemas, por ejemplo, presupuesto, alcance y responsabilidades, plazos y disponibilidad de recursos. 


Entrega actualizaciones de nivel ejecutivo sobre el estado del proyecto y los problemas que requieren resolución a los líderes senior del cliente en la faena minera. 


Formula recomendaciones estratégicas para el proyecto en colaboración con el Director del Programa y las partes interesadas clave de las distintas áreas. 





Desarrollo de Procesos y Colaboración




Entrega evaluaciones, comentarios y retroalimentación sobre las prácticas de gestión de proyectos utilizadas por el equipo, como reuniones de equipo, entre otras. 


Lidera capacitaciones para equipos, proveedores y consultores, comunicando políticas, procedimientos y prioridades. 


Lidera la preparación y el desarrollo de procesos de negocio para establecer y fortalecer la función de Gestión de Programas. 


Gestiona reuniones, realiza seguimiento de los compromisos y prepara la documentación pertinente necesaria para la ejecución de los proyectos. 


Se coordina con equipos multifuncionales para desarrollar planes y gestionar los calendarios de entrega. 


Trabaja de manera colaborativa y profesional con el equipo interno, proveedores externos, clientes y consultores. 


Lidera la comunicación con los responsables funcionales del proyecto y los integrantes del equipo respecto de la entrega de tareas y sus fechas de cumplimiento. 


Se comunica eficazmente de forma oral y escrita, lidera con el ejemplo, establece relaciones profesionales sólidas con clientes y colegas, y demuestra capacidad para informar a audiencias diversas en todos los niveles de la organización, así como a proveedores externos. 







Gestión de Relaciones con Clientes





Asegura que el cliente obtenga el valor esperado, de acuerdo con los objetivos establecidos en los acuerdos comerciales de la empresa. 


Comprende cómo el cliente obtiene valor mediante la implementación de la tecnología MineSense y cuáles son las distintas palancas que impulsan resultados exitosos. 


Trabaja de manera transversal con las organizaciones del cliente y de MineSense para identificar y resolver oportunamente los problemas, asegurando el desarrollo y la mantención de una relación de colaboración positiva en el tiempo. 


Es responsable del éxito del contrato comercial durante su vigencia, con miras a una eventual renovación. 


Realiza otras funciones que su jefatura pueda solicitar ocasionalmente. 












Requisitos Para el Cargo


Título profesional o licenciatura de cuatro años en una disciplina pertinente, por ejemplo, Ingeniería, Gestión de Proyectos o un área técnica o de negocios relacionada. 


Entre 4 y 6 o más años de experiencia en un entorno de Ingeniería o Desarrollo de Productos, idealmente en la industria minera. 


4 o más años de experiencia en la industria minera, incluidos 2 años en un cargo operativo en faena. 


Se requiere dominio de inglés a nivel laboral. 


Alto dominio de procesos de ejecución de proyectos por fases y puntos de control (Phase/Gate). 


Sólidas habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita. 


Capacidad para informar a audiencias diversas en todos los niveles de la organización, así como a proveedores externos. 


Persona proactiva, con capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y en equipo. 


Alto dominio de Microsoft 365. 


Compromiso con la salud y la seguridad.

ubicacion: Especialista Senior en Automatizacion e Instrumentacion - Santiago
descripcion_completa:
Mindco, empresa especialista en consultoría en gestión de activos para grandes industrias, se encuentra en la búsqueda de una/o Especialista en Automatización e Instrumentación para sumarse a nuestro equipo en un proyecto del rubro minero.


Para este cargo, se valorará experiencia en automatización, instrumentación y sistemas de control industrial, idealmente en minería, plantas de proceso o industrias de alta continuidad operacional. Buscamos un perfil con sólida experiencia técnica, capacidad de análisis y criterio para evaluar soluciones desde una perspectiva de criticidad, riesgo, mantenibilidad y contexto operacional.


Principales funciones:


 
 

Evaluar y definir los sensores, señales e instrumentación requeridos de acuerdo con la criticidad y condiciones operacionales de los activos.   


 
 
 

Determinar cuándo corresponde implementar monitoreo continuo, periódico o mediante inspección local/manual.   


 
 
 

Identificar señales críticas para mantenimiento, monitoreo de condición y continuidad operacional.   


 
 
 

Evaluar alternativas de automatización versus operación local o manual, considerando riesgo, confiabilidad y mantenibilidad.   


 
 
 

Definir requerimientos asociados a enclavamientos, interlocks y actuaciones automáticas frente a condiciones críticas.   


 
 
 

Evaluar la necesidad de secuencias automáticas de arranque y parada, redundancias de control y dependencia de sistemas PLC, DCS y SCADA.   


 
 
 

Identificar oportunidades de simplificación tecnológica cuando soluciones manuales o locales permitan controlar adecuadamente los riesgos operacionales.   


 
 
 

Participar junto a equipos de mantenimiento, confiabilidad y operación en la evaluación de alternativas técnicas, considerando criticidad, riesgo, mantenibilidad y costo.   


 

Requisitos:


 
 

Profesional titulado/a de Ingeniería Civil o Ingeniería de Ejecución en Automatización y Control, Electrónica, Electricidad, Instrumentación, Mecatrónica o carrera afín.   


 
 
 

Idealmente 10 años o más de experiencia en automatización, instrumentación o sistemas de control industrial.


 
 
 

Experiencia en el rubro minero, plantas de proceso o industrias de alta continuidad operacional.


 
 
 

Conocimiento práctico de PLC, DCS, SCADA, instrumentación de campo, sistemas de control, alarmas, enclavamientos e interlocks.


 
 
 

Experiencia trabajando en conjunto con áreas de mantenimiento, confiabilidad, operación o proyectos.   


 
 
 

Deseable formación complementaria en automatización industrial, instrumentación, control de procesos, confiabilidad o mantenimiento.   


 
 
 

Disponibilidad para realizar visitas a Terreno.   


 

En Mindco estamos comprometidos con la equidad, diversidad e inclusión. Si necesitas adaptaciones en tu proceso de selección, avísanos para brindarte la mejor experiencia posible.


¡Si cuentas con experiencia en automatización e instrumentación industrial y quieres participar en un desafío técnico de alto impacto en minería, postula ahora y únete a nuestro equipo!

descripcion_completa:
Take your business development career to the next level with a global mining technology leader.

Are you an ambitious business development professional ready to make your mark in the global mining industry? Do you thrive on opening new markets, building strong customer relationships and turning opportunities into commercial success?

This is an opportunity to join Acquire, a global mining software company, and play a key role in expanding our presence across Latin America. You’ll help leading mining and exploration organisations unlock greater value from their geoscience data, while building relationships with some of the most influential players in the resources sector.

Based in Chile, you’ll take ownership of new business development across the LATAM region, identifying opportunities, building a strong sales pipeline and positioning Acquire as a trusted partner for geoscience data management. Working closely with our regional operations, technical services and marketing teams, you’ll have the opportunity to influence our regional growth strategy and develop your career within an established global technology business.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who enjoys the challenge of winning new business, engaging with both technical specialists and senior decision-makers, and navigating complex sales opportunities. Whether you bring experience in mining technology, SaaS or B2B sales, you’ll have the opportunity to deepen your industry knowledge and make a tangible impact across one of the world’s most important mining regions.

What You’ll Do

As Business Development Manager – LATAM, you’ll play a pivotal role in growing Acquire’s customer base and developing new commercial opportunities across Latin America. You will:


Build, develop and convert a high-quality sales pipeline across mining and exploration customers throughout the LATAM region.
Drive proactive outbound sales activity to identify new prospects, open doors with target accounts and generate new business opportunities.
Develop a strong understanding of customer challenges and demonstrate how Acquire’s solutions can deliver value through compelling product demonstrations and presentations.
Lead sales proposals, commercial discussions and negotiations to progress opportunities and close new business.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across technical teams, geoscience functions, operational groups and senior executive leadership.
Work collaboratively with Technical Services, Operations and Marketing to deliver a coordinated customer experience and support regional growth objectives.
Represent Acquire at key industry conferences, trade shows and customer events, strengthening our market presence and building relationships across the mining sector.
Maintain accurate and insightful CRM records, ensuring effective pipeline management, sales forecasting and visibility of commercial opportunities.
Share market intelligence, customer feedback and competitive insights to inform product development and commercial strategy.


What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for a driven, commercially minded business development professional who enjoys creating opportunities, building relationships and delivering results. You’ll be motivated by the opportunity to grow a regional market and develop your career within a global mining technology business.

You’ll bring:


3–6 years’ experience in B2B sales, business development or account management, ideally within mining technology, software or SaaS.
A proven ability to identify prospects, build sales pipelines, develop new accounts and convert opportunities into revenue.
Confidence engaging with a broad range of stakeholders, from technical specialists and geoscientists to senior executives and commercial decision-makers.
A strong understanding of the mining and resources sector, including its customers, operating environments and commercial drivers.
Excellent communication, presentation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts in a clear and commercially relevant way.
Strong organisational skills, initiative and self-motivation, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across multiple sales opportunities.
A proactive, results-oriented approach and a genuine appetite to learn, grow and succeed in a business development role.


It would also be advantageous to have:


Experience working with mining software, geoscience applications or operational technology.
Experience managing sales cycles ranging from short-term opportunities to longer, more complex enterprise engagements.
Familiarity with Dynamics CRM or similar customer relationship management systems.
Experience representing a business at industry conferences, trade shows and customer events.
Professional proficiency in Spanish and the ability to engage effectively with customers across Latin America.


Why join Acquire?

At Acquire, you’ll have the opportunity to combine your commercial ambition with a meaningful role in the future of mining technology. You’ll work with a global team, engage with leading resources organisations and contribute directly to our continued growth across Latin America.

We offer:


Flexible hybrid working, with three days in the office and two days working remotely, subject to local arrangements.
Dedicated training levy and training leave to support your professional development and ongoing learning.
Specialised leave for volunteering and community-focused activities.
Sustainable commuter benefits that encourage greener transport options.
Social Club events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the business.
The opportunity to develop your career within a global mining software organisation backed by Constellation Software.
Exposure to international markets, leading mining customers and opportunities to grow your commercial and industry expertise.


About Acquire

Acquire provides strategic software solutions that help the world’s leading resource companies make confident, data-driven decisions.

Founded in Perth, Western Australia, Acquire has grown into a global mining technology business supporting customers across APAC, EMEA, North America and Latin America. Our solutions help organisations manage critical geoscience data and improve access to the information they need to make informed decisions across the resources value chain.

Since 2018, Acquire has been part of Constellation Software, Inc., through its operating group, Vela Software. This global backing provides a strong foundation for continued investment, innovation and growth, while enabling us to remain focused on delivering practical, customer-driven software solutions.

AI Is Everywhere. But Are We Using It Wisely?

Here I am, talking about AI again. 😊
Not because it’s a buzzword, but because AI is quietly becoming part of our everyday lives.
Think about it. We use AI to touch up a photo, plan our next trip, imagine a new look for our home, figure out what to cook tonight, learn something new, or answer one of those random questions that pops into our head.
We may not call it “using AI”. We just use it.

And the same shift is happening at work.
From GitHub Copilot and Claude in development, to Databricks Genie around data and AI in Figma for design & many more..., AI is increasingly becoming part of how we work.
But as our usage grows, there’s something all of us should understand i.e Tokens.
Simply put, what we give Generative AI and what it gives back is processed as tokens. Every interaction has consumption behind it.
So the real question isn't just, “Are we using AI?”
Are we saving time?
Reducing effort?
Improving quality?
Getting to outcomes faster?
But here’s where it gets interesting. Learning AI often looks like this:
Prompt.
Try.
Fail.
Change.
Try again.
Learn.
Is all that consumption waste? I don’t think so.
Sometimes that's exactly how we build confidence, capability and discover better ways of working.
This is something we try to practice within our Digitalization team too , giving people room to experiment and learn, while turning that learning into better productivity, improved quality and faster outcomes.
Of course, moving faster shouldn't mean switching off our judgement. Human-in-the-loop, security and governance need to grow alongside our AI adoption.

For me, AI maturity isn't simply about consuming fewer tokens.
It’s about knowing when to experiment, when to optimize, & whether what we create is delivering value.
Because sometimes...Prompt. Try. Fail. Change. Try again. Learn....isn't waste.
It’s how we move from simply using AI to becoming better at using it.
